title: Crafting AI-Driven Web Hierarchy: D3 Force Graphs and the Rule of 7
description: Architecting a navigable website structure by transforming content archives into a 'Rule of 7' hierarchy using D3 force graphs, enabled by AI-driven pre-processing and multi-API key strategies.
technical_challenges: Scaling AI processing with limited API quotas
Designing effective visualization for large link graphs

solution_components.name: AI Contextualizer
solution_components.function: Extracts metadata, summaries, sub-topics, and keywords from articles into JSON shards using Gemini.
solution_components.strategy: Multi-key rotation via Google Cloud Projects to bypass RPD limits.

solution_components.name: D3 Force Graph Visualization
solution_components.function: Visualizes website hierarchy, enforcing 'Rule of 7' (5-9 items per node) for user navigation.

solution_components.name: Graph Builder Script
solution_components.function: Converts flat JSON shards into the D3-compatible graph.json, synthesizing hierarchy nodes.

architecture_goal: Transforming flat content into a dynamic, AI-navigable tree, replacing pagination with drill-down navigation.
